scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.audio: Don't ever let your busy sales friends see this one. How much time do you spend typing, organizing data, and making quotes every day? I guess at least three hours, right?

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Let me tell you a story of a student of mine. He's in insurance. Just replying to client messages takes him two hours every day.

scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Every time he finishes meeting a client, he has to spend another hour at night sending messages to keep records. He told me, 'Teacher, it's not that I can't sell, it's that I really don't have time to meet clients.'

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: I taught him to use three tools. First, speech-to-text. After meeting a client, record a 3-minute summary on the phone in the car.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: AI will automatically organize it into meeting notes. He said that what used to take at least an hour to write, now takes only three minutes.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Second, AI helps him write personalized messages. He throws the client's data in, and AI automatically generates a warm response. It's not a canned message; it's really written based on that client's situation.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: Third, customized quotes. It used to take half an hour to make one quote.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Now, just throw in a few conditions and it's done in five minutes. Do you know what the result was? He gained two and a half extra hours a day, met two more clients, and closed four more cases in a month.

scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.audio: Just like a top chef won't wash the dishes himself, he needs to spend his time on creating and cooking. So your time should be spent in front of clients, not on typing.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: Comment 'Type' and I'll send you how to operate AI voice input. I am Tai Xin, helping you understand human nature and close high-value deals.
